標題： 🎓 東華大學113學年度畢業典禮現場直播公告Live Stream Announcement-NDHU 113th Academic Year Commencement Ceremony
日期： Fri, 23 May 2025 20:16:31 +0800

親愛的師長、家長與同學們，您好：
國立東華大學113學年度畢業典禮將於明天（5月24日）下午4點隆重登場，為了讓無法親臨現場的親友們也能一同參與並見證畢業生的重要時刻，我們將提供現場直播服務！
📍 直播時間：114年5月24日（星期六）下午3點40分開始
📍 直播連結：活動當日將公布於東華大學首頁（https://www.ndhu.edu.tw）
誠摯邀請大家線上共襄盛舉，為所有畢業生獻上最熱烈的祝福與掌聲！

敬祝
畢業快樂
學務處畢業典禮團隊  敬上


Dear Faculty, Parents, and Students,
The National Dong Hwa University Commencement Ceremony for the 113th Academic Year will take place tomorrow (May 24th) at 4:00 PM. To ensure that family and friends who cannot attend in person can still share in this meaningful moment, we are pleased to provide a live stream of the event.

📍Live Stream Time: Saturday, May 24th, 2025, starting at 3:40 PM
📍Live Stream Link: The link will be posted on the NDHU homepage on the day of the event (https://www.ndhu.edu.tw)

We warmly invite everyone to join us online to celebrate and applaud the accomplishments of our graduates.
Wishing you a joyful and memorable graduation day,
The Office of Student Affairs
